explanation: The AI response successfully identified all 7 dog breeds that consistently made the AKC top 10 rankings from 2013-2024 (Labrador Retriever, German Shepherd, Golden Retriever, Bulldog, Beagle, Poodle, and Rottweiler). However, it also included excessive breeds (French Bulldog, Yorkshire Terrier, Boxer) in its final summary list of consistent top 10 breeds, even contradicting its own table which showed those breeds falling out of the top 10 in certain years.
